scientific_integrity: The theorem follows from pair-color permanence and a finite-state exponential race; independent external audit not performed. The included script checks small instances using exact arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: Exact for fixed three-uniform loose hyperstars with simultaneous whole-edge binary majority and independent unit-rate edge clocks; does not cover rewiring, different group update rules, or general hypergraphs. Statistical computational checks are not a proof for unbounded petal count; the accompanying sample-path proof is all-size. Scientific priority remains subject to unindexed equivalent work.
title: Exact recurrent classes and consensus probability for majority voting on a loose hyperstar
